rules_sent_back.instruction: When the description states that an ongoing activity continues while, once a checkpoint or milestone is reached, another activity is started, and the two are described as running at the same time with no order or choice between them: Model a parallel gateway at the point where the checkpoint is reached. Give it one outgoing branch for the continuing activity and one for the newly started activity, both unconditional. Do not place an exclusive gateway or a decision condition on these concurrent branches, and do not sequence the continuing activity after the new one.
rules_sent_back.situation: the description states that one activity is carried out during another activity that is already running, with no order or choice between the two, so that both run at the same time and the second one is performed alongside the first

rules_sent_back.instruction: When the description states one send action toward a generic set of recipients in one sentence, and a later sentence names several distinct recipient groups, each receiving that same action: Model one send task per named recipient group, each labeled with the send action and that group's name as the description gives it, placed in the order the description gives. Do not replace the named groups with one generic collective task whose label hides them.
rules_sent_back.situation: the description states one send action toward a generic set of recipients in one sentence, and a later sentence names several distinct recipient groups, each receiving that same action

rules_sent_back.instruction: When the description says an external party, such as the customer, chooses among several options (for example, a set of alternatives or quantities) before the company starts production, and the choices determine what later teams build: Model each such choice as its own step performed by that external party: a user task placed in a separate participant or lane for that party, with one task per decision the description names, sequenced before the production activities that depend on it. Do not fold the choices into a single generic input or into the company's own work step.
rules_sent_back.situation: the description says an external party, such as the customer, chooses among several options (for example, a set of alternatives or quantities) before the company starts production, and the choices determine what later teams build

rules_sent_back.instruction: When the description says the customer selects one value for each configurable attribute of the product, and the value chosen determines which of several downstream partner parties receives a request for that part; the alternatives are described as an either/or selection: Model the selection as an exclusive split gateway with one outgoing sequence flow per possible value. Each flow leads to its own send task addressed to the party responsible for that value. Join the alternative send paths with an exclusive merge gateway before the next common step. Do not route the request for all values through one generic send task, and do not use a parallel gateway for these alternatives.
rules_sent_back.situation: the description says the customer selects one value for each configurable attribute of the product, and the value chosen determines which of several downstream partner parties receives a request for that part; the alternatives are described as an either/or selection
